# Teal

> Teal is a career discovery and job search platform offering virtual workshops, coaching, and strategic guidance to help professionals find purpose-driven work.

Teal provides career coaching and job search strategy resources through virtual workshops and webinars. The platform is built around helping professionals discover their ideal career path and develop effective job search strategies.

## Key Topics

- Career Discovery
- Job Search Strategy
- Career Planning
- Purpose Framework
- Career Coaching
- Virtual Workshops
- Talentism
- Julia Markish
- David Fano
- Webinars

## Career Discovery & Workshops

- [Discovering Your Work](https://events.tealhq.com/): Virtual workshop on career discovery and job search strategy by Teal
